study.question: Does a separate content-and-rate residual improve on both frozen source bests and the current composed incumbent, and which of centered content-feedback products, raw local feedback rates, or added content-readout capacity explains the small observed composition gain?
study.hypothesis: Observation: g2-r0018-joint_exposure scored macro AUC 0.8314801529004078 versus g0-r0013-pair_joint_both 0.8314095190610717 (delta +0.0000706338393360), g2-r0016-diversity_factorized 0.8281021879164492, and adapted baseline-din 0.8099233880793816. The near-tied diversity cell scored 0.8314791068566854; diversity minus exposure is -0.0000010460437224. Marginal pair replacements fell to 0.8308674678240657 and 0.8308587736085302. All seven authorized receipts succeeded; no failed training is present in this scoped evidence, and no unprovided older branches are treated as evidence. Joint-pair utility is provisionally supported in this one-seed composition, diversity-specific utility is not. The exposure composition adds 20,036 dense parameters (1,303,465 vs 1,283,429), raises wall cost 533.32 to 555.33 seconds and validation inference 41.30 to 43.15 seconds. Its task AUC deltas versus g0 in click/cart/fav/buy order are [-0.000034348677, +0.000088287341, +0.000072174876, +0.000156421817]; task Logloss deltas are [+0.000019124883, -0.000013816664, -0.000009673494, -0.000002021610]. Macro Logloss is 0.05458713399121181 vs g0 0.054588730712398906. Thus the tiny macro gain includes a click regression. Mechanism hypothesis: the factorized, user-centered product may attenuate content already useful to the stronger g0 representation. In exact arithmetic its per-slot moment is q_s * alpha_s * (f_st - b_t), with alpha=n/(n+4). If local and user feedback fractions coincide, the product vanishes although mean content can still vary. Supplying q_s and raw f_st as separate inputs lets the same small residual MLP learn their usefulness without this fixed suppression. Added readout capacity or raw feedback rates alone remain live alternatives; the existing results establish neither the proposed attenuation explanation nor a new mechanism.

study.proposed_difference: Three new standalone variants complete a 2x2 representation replacement study with the archived fourth cell. A=moment input: centered_product (the incumbent q_s*alpha*(f-b)) or content (q_s replicated over the four task blocks). B=explicit rate columns: feedback (raw local fractions f_st) or exposure (n_s/100 repeated over four columns). Candidate content_rates=(content,feedback) retains separate content and rates. Control product_counts=(centered_product,exposure) retains feedback only in the product. Control content_counts=(content,exposure) contains no feedback in the appended residual, while the inherited core still does. Archived g2-r0018-joint_exposure=(centered_product,feedback) is the full cell. This is a replacement factorial, not an additive ANOVA of binary module presence: removing products restores unattenuated content and changes scale. All three new files are identical except literal CONFIG. No module constructors, initialization order, learned parameters, forward masking, current-action sanitation or output interface change. All summary work still executes, including the unused covariance/diversity diagnostics. New selectors act only after the inherited moment is formed. Exact historical control reuse requires the original selection to take the unmodified path; static equivalence is checked, runtime BF16 equivalence remains a host prerequisite. Candidate selection is the frozen macro-AUC rule, with macro Logloss, parameter count and ID tie-breakers; do not declare a per-task veto. This is local attribution and a falsifiable representation modification; originality relative to all external work is unverified.
predictions: If fixed attenuation is consequential under the one-pass recipe, content_rates will exceed archived full g2-r0018-joint_exposure and both source bests in validation macro AUC. A gain over g0 alone is insufficient to support improvement over the incumbent.

Compare raw-rate gains within each content input: content_rates minus content_counts, and archived full minus product_counts. Positive repeated contrasts support incremental use of local feedback fractions in the appended branch; equality favors content/capacity or core redundancy explanations.

Compare moment replacements with rates held fixed: content_rates minus archived full, and content_counts minus product_counts. Compute their difference-in-differences on macro AUC and on every task, describing it as metric interaction rather than a causal coefficient. A consistent content-replacement advantage supports that representation choice; it does not uniquely prove attenuation rather than scale or conditioning.

If content_counts matches or exceeds the archived full cell and content_rates, the small composition benefit is compatible with extra content-readout capacity; no g2 feedback-specific utility should be claimed.

Predeclared history bins remain empty,1-16,17-64,>64; use host counts/positives/negatives for all tasks and mark sparse buy/empty slices exploratory. Prior exposure gain versus g0 was +0.0002516690 for1-16,+0.000137026999 for17-64,-0.000119193636 for>64 and -0.00051122634 for empty; this is mixed evidence, not a uniform history effect. No new unavailable hour/frequency/composition diagnostics are promised.

Nominal parameters should stay 33,096,681 total /1,303,465 dense, with zero added tokens; actual host counts and train/inference latency must be reported. Fixed recipe gives a matched-data-pass comparison, not an equal-compute claim.
falsifiers: content_rates failing to exceed 0.8314801529004078 opposes predictive improvement over the current incumbent; failure to exceed0.8314095190610717 opposes improvement over the stronger frozen source. Either remains a valid null result.

A content replacement advantage that disappears or reverses on paired validation seeds opposes a repeatable utility claim. Missing repetitions leave the conclusion preliminary; one failure does not refute every possible content/rate implementation.
content_counts matching the full cell, or no positive feedback-rate contrast, opposes attribution of the existing gain to g2 feedback information.

No positive centered-product contrast in either rate setting opposes unique predictive value of the centered product; products winning would contradict the proposed content-restoration direction while supporting further study of feedback coupling.

Parameter/initialization/source identity mismatch, nonfinite forward or loss/gradient, any padded-ID or masked-feedback sensitivity, current target-action sensitivity, or nonzero direct empty-history residual invalidates the affected comparison until repaired within budget. Unavailable tensor execution is missing prerequisite evidence, not a scientific falsification.
alternative_explanations: Equal nominal parameters and active content projection do not match effective input rank, feature scale, conditioning or backward cost; repeated content/count columns are redundant.
The core g0 path still receives historical action embeddings and task masks. Removing residual feedback does not remove all feedback from the model.
All modules train jointly; changes in empty-history predictions can arise through shared embedding/tower training despite an exactly zero direct residual on empty histories.

One fixed-seed run and validation reuse cannot establish significance or novelty. Archived full-cell reuse assumes exact source/config/protocol/seed/data/host identity; host must verify these before treating it as matched.

The residual MLP may learn the useful content-feedback coupling from separate inputs without needing the fixed product, or the strong g0 memory/pair paths may already encode it. A replacement gain alone cannot separate these explanations.
The archived difference may be fixed-seed optimization noise, including shared embedding updates, weak low-support feedback estimates, or validation selection bias after earlier search.

The user background includes each local slot and is not an independent prior. Exposure counts measure repetitions rather than independent support; the historical diversity-null result does not prove exposure is correct in every population.

Auxiliary labels match user/category/brand within24h, not advertisement-specific conversions. Whole-window vocabularies/static snapshots and official_offline delayed feedback are inherited; no production point-in-time effectiveness claim is authorized.

Original EST text is unavailable in the authorized snapshot; prior-art completeness is limited. DIN primary mechanism is read but its exact adaptation fidelity and this design's novelty are separate questions.
